children: Stripping out one-time items, Malibu Boats' fourth-quarter adjusted earnings were 82 cents a share, beating analyst projections for 78 cents a share. "Malibu Boats Sets Higher Sales Target as Prices Increase," at 7:44 a.m. ET on Aug. 27, incorrectly said the company's adjusted EPS was 92 cents. The company has since corrected that figure.
